name: dt-chatgpt
_comment: ChatGPT logged-out cookie dialog (dialog#cookie-consent, form buttons name=action value=reject|accept). Top-50 CZ sweep 2026-11-11. No closing check: the buttons submit a form (POST /unauth-mweb/privacy) that reloads the page and would interrupt it; the refusal is the oai_consent_analytics/marketing=false cookies.
